name: ba-popup-interrupter
description: A browser extension that annoys you periodically.

scripts.lint:ext:firefox: npm run build && npm run build:firefox-manifest && web-ext lint --source-dir=../ba-popup-interrupter-dist-firefox
scripts.start:firefox: npm run build && npm run build:firefox-manifest && web-ext run --source-dir=../ba-popup-interrupter-dist-firefox
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build && npm run build:firefox-manifest && web-ext build --source-dir=../ba-popup-interrupter-dist-firefox --artifacts-dir=web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest --filename={name}-{version}-firefox.zip
